title: Türkmen atlary
description:
I built a Türkmen Atlar application using Flutter, where users can quickly search and discover the meanings of Turkmen names. 
🔍 Fast & clean search 
⭐ Save favorites 
📱 Modern and simple UI 
🌍 Available for everyone 
📥 Now available on the App Store

title: German Quiz
description:
🚀 Launching German Quizes
 Practice German anywhere with fast, focused offline quizzes—perfect for daily vocabulary and grammar reps. When you need extra help, the built-in AI provides hints and explanations (internet required for AI only).

What’s inside
📴 Offline quizzes for on-the-go practice
🤖 AI tutor for tips/explanations (online)
📊 Results screen to track progress
🧩 Topic-based sets for quick sessions

title: Chatbot AI
description:
I’m excited to share my latest project: an AI Chatbot Application built with Flutter and Firebase.

Key Features:
 • AI-powered text-based conversation – users can ask questions and receive instant responses.
 • Secure authentication – implemented with Firebase Authentication for reliable login and signup.
 • Clean and responsive UI – optimized for a smooth cross-platform experience.

Tech Stack:
 • Flutter (cross-platform mobile development)
 • Firebase Authentication (secure user management)
 • REST API integration for AI responses
This project allowed me to strengthen my skills in API integration, state management, and authentication workflows while maintaining high performance and usability.

title: Turkmen Names
description:
🚀 New App Release – 'Türkmen Adam Atlary' 🇹🇲
I’m excited to share my latest Flutter project: Türkmen Adam Atlary — a mobile application that showcases the meanings of traditional Turkmen male and female names.

💡 Main Features:
 • Built with Flutter (Dart)
 • Offline support with local JSON data
 • Favorites system to save preferred names
 • Organized by gender: Male / Female
 • Clean and responsive UI

🌱 This project reflects both my technical growth as a Flutter developer and my passion for preserving Turkmen cultural heritage.

title: Turkmen Tagamlary
description:
🌟 Excited to share my second mobile app: Türkmen Tagamlary 🇹🇲📱
Türkmen Tagamlary is a Flutter-based app that introduces users to the rich and unique flavors of Turkmen cuisine.
From traditional dishes to herbal teas like Narpyzly Çaý and Ýandakly Çaý, this app brings the essence of Turkmen culture to your fingertips.
💡 Built with Flutter
 🎨 UI/UX designed by me
 🧩 Culturally inspired content

This is my second mobile app, and I’m proud to keep learning, growing, and building new things.

title: Kitaplar
description:
🚀 Excited to share my latest project!
 I've developed a new Android mobile application called'Kitaplar', built with Flutter and powered by a Django backend.
📚 The app includes a wide collection of books by Turkmen and English authors, as well as school textbooks — all in one place.
 The goal is to promote reading and make educational materials easily accessible.
🛠️ Tech Stack:
Flutter (Frontend)
Django REST Framework (Backend)
Syncfusion PDF Viewer
Clean UI & responsive design

title: Computer Basics
description:
🚀 I'm excited to share my first Android application — Computer Basics!
A simple app to help beginners understand the fundamentals of computer hardware and software.
 🛠️ Built with Java using Android Studio
🎯 It's just the beginning of my journey as a developer.

title: Langora Academy
description:
🚀 New Project: Langora Academy
As a self-employed frontend developer, I built this online learning platform using React.js.
 Langora Academy offers courses in German, English, and Math.
🔧 Tech Highlights:
Multilingual support via i18nextn
Fully responsive UI
Clean component-based architecture
I was fully responsible for the frontend development of this freelance project.

title: Dil Menzili
description: A multilingual online course platform built with Flutter, allowing users to register for courses, explore teacher profiles, receive news and updates, and switch seamlessly between 5 different languages. The app supports real-time content updates and is designed for accessible, cross-cultural learning.

title: Lezzetli Tagamlar
description:
🚀 I'm excited to share my latest project!
I've developed a mobile application called 'Lezzetli Tagamlar' using Flutter. The app provides users with a variety of sweet recipes such as cookies, cakes, and chocolate desserts – all in the Turkmen language.

🔧 Tech stack: Flutter (Dart)
 🖼️ Content: Traditional and modern dessert recipes in Turkmen
 📦 Distribution: Android APK
This app is designed for dessert lovers who enjoy baking at home – it works offline and features high-quality visuals.

title: Very Simple Portfolio Website
description: Created a clean and minimal portfolio website to showcase one developer projects and skills, using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Note App
description:
I’ve just completed my new Flutter project: Note App📝

NotPad is a simple and clean note-taking app where users can add, view, and delete their notes.
Built with Flutter and Dart
Local data storage with SharedPreferences
Fully functional UI with navigation
I continue improving my Flutter skills with hands-on projects.

title: Library App
description:
🚀 New Project Completed – Library App (Flutter + Django + Firebase)
I'm excited to share my latest mobile app project: Library App, built using Flutter for the frontend and Django REST Framework for the backend.

🧩 Key Features:
 ✅ User Registration & Login (Firebase Authentication)
 ✅ Secure Logout & Account Deletionn
 ✅ Book List fetched from a Django REST API
 ✅ Clean and responsive UI built with Flutter

🔧 Tech Stack:
Flutter (Frontend)
Firebase (Authentication)
Django REST Framework (Backend/API)
This project allowed me to deepen my skills in mobile development, API integration, and secure authentication. It was a great learning experience combining multiple technologies to build a functional and scalable app.
